topography.project_purpose: Derivatives. Structurally: 73 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 10 ERC20 tokens, 3 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 10 functional families. Its contracts share 18 common project-authored base contract(s) (memorymap, primefieldelement0, reentrant). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
